Name: Witchy White Cat
Author: ModularCocoon
Description:
This mod adds a new cat breed to the game! Complete with a witchy hat for full immersion, this perfect little friend will keep you company on your farm day and night. 

 Inspired by [url=https://www.instagram.com/simple.hylian/]Simple Hylian[/url]'s cat, Charlie. Go check out her stuff!

Downloads.Description: Simply download this mod via your mod manager, or add it to Stardew Valley/Mods

Manifest.Name: Ash's Cat
Manifest.Description: Adds SimpleHylian's cat to the game.
